# ataila_ai_rate_card (Data Source)

The platform's AI rate card: the list rate per serving tier, EUR per one million input and output tokens — in force today (`current`), the next scheduled change (`upcoming`) and the history. Tiers the platform knows appear even without a rate (`current` null: their usage is not priced). Needs a token holding `ai-gateway-read-global` (or `ai-gateway-admin-global`) and platform release 1.0.237 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_ai_rate_card" "list" {}

# Tiers whose usage is not priced yet.
output "unpriced_tiers" {
  value = [for t in data.ataila_ai_rate_card.list.tiers : t.tier if t.current == null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `as_of` (String) Today, in the billing time zone.
- `currency` (String) Always `EUR`.
- `history` (Attributes List) Every list rate ever set, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Per tier, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))
- `unit` (String) Always `1M tokens`.

<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `eur_per_1m_input` (Number) EUR per one million input (prompt) tokens.
- `eur_per_1m_output` (Number) EUR per one million output (completion) tokens.
- `note` (String) The operator's note.
- `set_at` (String) When it was set. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `set_by` (String) The user who set it (`id` on a user); null when that user no longer exists.
- `tier` (String) The serving tier, e.g. `general`, `code`, `embed`.
- `valid_from` (String) The first billing day the rate applies.
- `valid_to` (String) The last billing day it applies; null while it is open.


<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Read-Only:

- `current` (Attributes) The list rate in force today; null when the tier has none (not priced). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--current))
- `seedable` (Boolean) Whether the platform's cloud-anchored seed can price this tier.
- `tier` (String) The serving tier, e.g. `general`, `code`, `embed`.
- `upcoming` (Attributes) The next scheduled change; null when none is scheduled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--upcoming))

<a id="nestedatt--tiers--current"></a>
